2. A curated roundup of recent NEAR ecosystem news (with sources). Save it as `ecosystem_news.json`.
3. A practical staking tutorial for developers. Save it as `staking_tutorial.md`.

There's a SKILL.md somewhere in the skills folder that explains how to use the tooling. Please read it carefully — the tool has specific command names and output format requirements that matter for publishing. All three files can be saved anywhere under `/workspace/`.
